div.p: The following adjacency list represents the friendship between people. Which statement is correct?

img.alt: Adjacency list of friendships between people: Vertex Tim with adjacent vertices (edges) Bella and Harry; Vertex Harry with adjacent vertices (edges) Hank, Tina, Rody, and Tim; Vertex Bob with adjacent vertices (edges) Bella and Rody; Vertex Tina with adjacent vertices (edges) Rita and Hank; Vertex Hank with adjacent vertices (edges) Tina, Rody, Bella, and Sam; Vertex Bella with adjacent vertices (edges) Tim, Bob, and Hank; Vertex Sam with adjacent vertex (edge) Hank; Vertex Rody with adjacent vertices (edges) Harry, Bob, and Hank; and Vertex Rita with adjacent vertex (edge) Tina.

div.p: Harry is directly friends with Rody
Bob is directly friends with Hank
Hank can introduce Tim to Bob
Rita can introduce Bella to Tina
